note: Each line starts at its scene's start plus `at` seconds. demo/tool/voice.py speaks or slices the lines, places them, and fails if one runs into the next. `say` respells words for the synthetic voice only (Curre is said KOO-reh).

lines.text: Two weeks before exams, Tobi's phone keeps pulling him away.
One quick look, and an hour is gone.
Curre is a home screen for a focus period.
Setting up takes about a minute.
Tobi says what the focus is for, passing his finals, and when it ends: two weeks from today.
Then, what pulls him in.
Only the apps he picks get hidden. Everything else opens as usual.
And Curre becomes his home screen.
Every session starts with one sentence, in plain words.
Fill picks the apps this phone really has. Extract copies the exact words: G chord lesson, until seven.
Each door goes straight to the task.
YouTube opens on the search, not on the feed.
Open a hidden app, and Curre asks: why now?
Just checking something sounds like browsing, so it can wait.
There's no hard lock. It still opens after thirty seconds.
A real reason opens it right away.
Someone's waiting, so Instagram opens at the chat with Ada, for five minutes.
And when a reason tries to give Curre orders, Guard calmly flags it.
Hidden apps can't sneak back in through notifications, either.
Curre holds them quietly, on the phone, and deletes nothing.
One day a week, Tobi takes a rest day.
His hidden apps open freely, and what was held is given back.
A week in, Tobi finishes the lesson.
A tick isn't proof, so Curre asks what changed.
Decide checks it's a real completion, Extract finds what he learned, and Verify checks it against the plan.
Seven proof days. The rest day didn't break the run.
And on Home, the evening's water rises.
What he saved for later comes back at the next check-in.
Rerank brings what fits tonight's plan to the top, and leaves the rest.
When the exams are over, so is Curre's job.
Tobi sees what two weeks added up to, then goes back to his old home screen in one tap.
Under the hood, every screen makes one Clocked pipeline call.
Fill and Extract build the plan. Protect, Guard, Decide and Extract answer why now. Proof adds Verify. Rerank sorts the shelf.
The server stores nothing. It all stays on the phone.
Curre. Straight to what you came for.
